description: Client-side script defining the ItemConfigure class for product configuration UI, including dialog management, attribute selection, range input handling, and cart addition.

classes.name: ItemConfigure
classes.description: Handles product attribute configuration dialog, range inputs, and cart interactions.

methods.name: show_configure_dialog
methods.description: Initializes and displays the configuration dialog with attribute options.

methods.name: on_attribute_selection
methods.description: Handles attribute selection changes, updates options, and manages range inputs.

methods.name: show_range_input_for_all_fields
methods.description: Displays range inputs for all fields if applicable.

methods.name: show_range_input_if_applicable
methods.description: Displays a range input control if the attribute value suggests a range.

methods.name: update_range_values
methods.description: Stores selected range values for attributes.

methods.name: show_remaining_optional_attributes
methods.description: Displays optional attributes that are unselected.

methods.name: set_loading_status
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator in the dialog.

methods.name: set_item_found_status
methods.description: Displays search result status and add-to-cart option.

methods.name: clear_status
methods.description: Clears status messages in the dialog.

methods.name: get_html_for_item_found
methods.description: Generates HTML for search results and actions.

methods.name: btn_add_to_cart
methods.description: Adds selected item to shopping cart and clears cache.

methods.name: btn_clear_values
methods.description: Resets attribute options and clears dialog.

methods.name: append_status_area
methods.description: Adds a status message area to the dialog.

methods.name: get_next_attribute_and_values
methods.description: Fetches next attribute options based on current selections.

methods.name: get_attributes_and_values
methods.description: Fetches all attribute options for the item.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Returns cache key for current item configuration.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Wraps frappe.call in a Promise for async operations.
